info.title: SpeechNexus binding default producer contract
info.description: Contract-only extension for creating a new binding revision with explicitly declared parameter defaults and reading its fixed snapshot. This profile does not advertise implemented operational routes or prove persistence, authority, publication or qualification. Legacy admin 0.1.0.dev3 remains the implemented draft contract until the producer is wired.

post.summary: Create an immutable draft binding revision
post.description:
Creates a new immutable revision in draft state. The registry allocates
the family revision and a globally unique revision_id; the caller cannot
supply either identity. Independent successful commands append distinct
revisions, preserving earlier history. supersedes_revision records a
supersession relationship; it is not an expected-head CAS guard.
Publishing requires separate capacity and qualification evidence.

Optional parameter_defaults explicitly declares sparse canonical parameter
values for this new revision. Omission creates no defaults declaration;
an explicit empty object declares no defaults. Null is not omission.
The registry allocates the snapshot identity and fixed parent references,
and commits the new revision and at most one snapshot atomically. The
caller supplies binding_id as before, but cannot supply snapshot_id,
allocated revision/revision_id or timestamps. Values
must fit the binding's tasks and parameter domains before commit; a
structurally valid but incompatible declaration returns 422. No engine
defaults are probed or inferred. Existing revisions are never amended.
The binding response shape is unchanged; its exact identity addresses
the fixed parameter-defaults GET. This declaration is not publication,
producer authentication, engine qualification or a default pointer.

Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and canonical complete intent returns
the original revision before any allocation. The same key with a different
intent returns 409 idempotency_conflict without allocating a new revision.
Complete intent includes parameter_defaults presence and every explicit
value: omission and an empty object are different intents. Recovery must
return the original snapshot as well as the original binding identity;
later configuration cannot populate or replace that snapshot.
Malformed JSON, unknown fields and invalid header/schema values return 400;
structurally valid but inconsistent binding composition returns 422.

An unreadable original result or uncertain commit returns 503
binding_result_unknown with retryable: false. It does not establish that
no revision was created. There is no automatic retry, new key, Operation
or query-by-key recovery resource. A caller retaining the original key
may explicitly replay this same POST with the exact original intent and
key to resolve that result. Without an original key automatic recovery
is not promised; a candidate revision GET does not prove original-command
ownership. Receive refusals do not settle an earlier original-key outcome.

The bounded public ingress may refuse Host/Origin (403), unsupported
method (405 with Allow), receive timeout (408), request size (413),
non-JSON media (415), or local receive capacity (429). Limits are deployment
configuration, not implicit binding parameters or qualification evidence.

get.summary: Get the explicit default parameter snapshot of one fixed binding revision
get.description:
Reads only the snapshot allocated with this exact binding revision.
Snapshot binding_id and binding_revision must match the path and its
binding_revision_id must identify the same authoritative parent. These
cross-resource checks are producer obligations, not schema-only proof.
Never selects a latest/current/default revision, allocates a snapshot or
fills engine/schema defaults. An explicit parameters: {} is a successful
declaration; a missing declaration is not that value. Return 404
binding_defaults_not_found only after an authoritative read confirms no
snapshot for this parent, including absent parents and legacy revisions
created without a declaration. Do not manufacture empty defaults.
Unreadable parent/snapshot facts return 503 binding_unavailable with
retryable: true for this same fixed GET; this is not absence, permission
to repeat a creation under a new key, or proof of original-key ownership.
A create result remains recoverable only through its original POST,
complete intent and retained key. No keyless recovery is introduced.
Invalid path/header/query values or read body/framing return 400.
Host/Origin refusal uses 403; unsupported methods use 405 with Allow.
Reading a declaration proves neither publication nor engine capability
or the final merged parameter configuration.

200.description: Immutable explicit declaration for the exact parent revision.

404.description: Authoritative read confirms no default declaration for this fixed parent.

parameter_defaults.description: Explicit sparse values. Omission creates no declaration; {} explicitly declares none. No schema default populates a value.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

External_binding_parameter_defaults_sche.description: Explicit sparse canonical parameter fields. Nested objects retain their original required fields. No schema annotation supplies an omitted value. An explicit empty map declares no defaults and is not a substitute for an absent/unreadable snapshot.

External_shared_profile_parameter_values.description: Must be greater than or equal to preview_interval_ms and is further bounded by the binding, auxiliary capabilities, and workspace policy at admission. JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field comparison; contract tests and runtime validation enforce it.

External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.title: ModelBindingRevision
External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.description: Immutable logical-model binding from a public model name to engine, artifacts, execution recipe, parameter domains, capacity manifest, and qualification evidence. It is separate from any runtime instance, generation, lease, or readiness fact.

revision_id.description: Globally unique immutable identifier for this exact (binding_id, revision). Capacity manifests, qualification reports, runtime instances, leases, submit intents, and receipts use this value as binding_revision_id.

logical_model.description: Public logical model name returned by GET /v1/models and accepted in model request fields. It is not an engine model path.

release_tier.description: Publication claim for this revision. A draft may target production without evidence identifiers; any published, retired, or disabled production revision requires the bound capacity manifest and qualification report.

publication.description: Mutable lifecycle projection over the immutable binding definition. Drafts cannot carry publication timestamps or evidence identifiers.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

examples.description: File and full-segment review ASR binding.
Realtime ASR binding with VAD preview and full-segment review.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

External_binding_parameter_defaults_sche.title: BindingParameterDefaultsSnapshot
External_binding_parameter_defaults_sche.description: Registry-owned immutable declaration of profile-compatible default parameter values for one exact binding revision. Omission, explicit null and an explicit empty parameter map remain distinct. It is a declaration, not an engine-default probe or publication evidence. Parent identity, producer authority and final parameter compatibility are checked separately. It defines no create/get operation.

BindingDefaultParameters.description: Explicit sparse canonical parameter fields. Nested objects retain their original required fields. No schema annotation supplies an omitted value. An explicit empty map declares no defaults and is not a substitute for an absent/unreadable snapshot.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingDraft.description: The original key belongs to a different complete intent; no new revision.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_Unprocessabl.description: Invalid binding, capacity, qualification, or policy composition.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_Forbidden.description: The deployment Host or Origin policy refused the request.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingCreat.description: The selected draft creation path accepts POST only.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingRecei.description: The bounded JSON receive deadline expired; no new outcome is inferred.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingReque.description: Actual or declared request bytes exceed the configured ingress bound.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingMedia.description: Draft creation requires application/json encoded as UTF-8.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingRecei.description: Local bounded receive capacity is full; earlier original-key state is unknown.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingCreat.description: Original creation result unreadable or commit uncertain; retain original intent/key.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingReadM.description: The selected fixed revision path accepts GET only.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_BindingReadU.description: Fixed revision could not be read; this does not confirm absence.

External_admin_openapi_yaml_SharedServic.description: Optional deployment-wide shared credential; not a user identity.
